scope: Resource isolation of E24 short-task regression: compiler/run CPU, unlink and last close

method.controls: resident; restore after tool; progress return drop; progress early unlink; early unlink with private fd retained through tool completion
method.calibration: Three complete tasks per state, same initial labels, independent per-mode past-only EWMA
method.order: Forward and reverse cyclic Latin order; each mode occupies every position twice
method.resource_units: wait4 user/system ms, faults and IO operations; Mach gauges bytes and global VM counters pages; global deltas not exclusive attribution
method.costs: Save/tools/repair/final suffix/metrics parsing/cleanup included; initial history/load/calibration/measured oracle excluded

limits: Sparse diagnostic sampling and trusted tool driver add common overhead; no cross-run subtraction from E24
Cached IO counters may be zero; zero counts do not exclude filesystem CPU or memory contention
CPU may exceed wall for parallel compiler children; wall minus CPU is not an IO estimate
Global VM deltas include external system activity; no frequency, physical SSD bandwidth or per-page cache tracing
Only same live engine/session/revision; normal resident path does not require snapshots; logical eviction does not shrink physical KV
One M5/Metal/Qwen0.6B; scripted real tools, no autonomous-model or Windows/CUDA claim

sanitizers.scope: Native14K/KV/Stream, held slot accounting, duplicate/in-use unlink and stale restore rejection, waiting/inflight/ready cancellation; cxf/adapters instrumented, upstream prebuilt excluded

cli_integration.scope: Native CLI registration/store/worker/tool path with deterministic Native-parser actions
